name: Kunoichi Gokumonchou 2 ~Bijo Kenshi Gekitou Hen~
original_name: くノ一獄悶帖2 ～美女剣士激闘編～
source:
She infiltrates the village of Kazema and steals the secret scroll.
A beautiful and fierce swordswoman pursues her to get the scroll back.
Each a master of her respective way, each willing to use her sexuality to gain the advantage,
the kunocihi and the kenshi begin a lesbian battle of the flesh. It begins!
